MAYA AGENT #1

Customer Service.

Complete inbound call management and lead triage

See Maya in action

An expert.
By your side, 24/7.

Maya Agent #1 is the first voice your customers hear. She answers every call in less than one ring, 24 hours a day, in English and French. She identifies the caller's intent, takes messages and routes each request to the right person.

No missed calls, no lost opportunities — even at 3 a.m.
